body: Create production sprite atlas for Gut BODY ONLY, no spear or weapons drawn anywhere. Reference identifies exact man, glasses short black hair beard stocky build and detailed pixel-art fighting game style. 1536x1024 transparent alpha, SIX columns FOUR rows, 24 separate figures with clear gutters. TOP TWO ROWS white shirt blue dress trousers dark shoes, BOTTOM TWO ROWS same twelve poses black sleeveless red-trim kungfu uniform. Every body faces RIGHT at same anatomical scale with hands curled gripping an INVISIBLE spear shaft; separate weapon will be composited later, DO NOT draw any shaft blade tassel or effects. First row of each skin: SIX walking poses alternating left and right legs, guard posture with two hands aligned diagonally from rear hand at waist-left to forward hand at chest-right, gentle bent knees, alternate feet lifted. Second row of each skin: 1 standing guard hands aligned diagonal up-right; 2 forward thrust, two hands extended level at chest; 3 horizontal sweep hands level across waist; 4 upward thrust, rear hand at chest and forward hand up-right above head; 5 low crouch thrust, hands aligned horizontally at knee-height; 6 airborne downward dive, legs tucked behind, rear hand at upper-left shoulder and front hand extended lower-right. Closed grip hands with small round empty opening for shaft, NO weapon drawn. No text/background/ground/shadows. Preserve body scale across skins. Clean complete silhouettes every cell.
bodyCorrection: Precise edit of supplied transparent 6-column 4-row Gut sprite sheet. ONLY correct the FIFTH figure of SECOND ROW (crouching forward thrust): replace its black/red kungfu clothing with WHITE rolled-sleeve dress shirt, BLUE dress trousers and dark dress shoes exactly like all other figures in top two rows. Keep that figure pose, size, hands and position. Preserve every other pixel/figure layout/style. All top two rows must be white shirt skin; bottom two rows black/red skin. Keep true transparent alpha, 1536x1024. No weapons.
weapon: Single isolated Chinese kungfu spear game sprite, horizontal pointing RIGHT. Match wooden brown shaft, silver leaf-shaped metal blade and small red tassel of supplied reference, crisp detailed pixel illustration style. One perfectly straight very long thin wooden shaft from LEFT butt to RIGHT blade, consistent thickness. Silver spearhead about 9% of total weapon length; red tassel hangs just below blade socket, about 12% of weapon length. Full spear from butt to point inside canvas, 8% transparent margin all sides. 1536x1024 true transparent alpha background. Weapon aligned horizontal at midheight, only one spear, no person, hands, labels, scenery, glow or shadows. This will be rendered at fixed 4.3 meter length next to 1.8 meter fighter, keep blade/tassel suitably proportioned.
